azure.message: The account name the Azure CLI uses is shaped like a credential (a token prefix or an unbroken run of 24 or more letters and digits), so it is not used and not shown. Signed in to tenant 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111 (AzureCloud).
azure.next_step: Run az account list --output json yourself to see the sign-in, or sign in with an ordinary account: az login --tenant 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111; then run this command again.

output.note: A signed-in account does not establish Graph, Intune or state-storage access; those stay unknown until a read actually succeeds.
